description_en: Queries the scheduling configuration of a ticket for cleaning up historical data
description_zh: 查询历史数据清理工单的定时配置
name: GetDataCronClearConfig

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ticket. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144643.html operation to query the ticket ID
parameters.help_zh: 工单ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144643.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: order_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

: To view the ID of the tenant, go to the Data Management (DMS) console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

CronCallTimes.description_en: The number of times that the task is run

CronFormat.description_en: The crontab expression that you can use to run the task at a specified time. For more information, see [Crontab expression]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206581.html）
CronFormat.description_zh: Crontab表达式，以便定期执行任务。更多信息，请参见[Crontab表达式]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206581.html）

CronLastCallStartTime.description_en: The time when the task was last run

CronNextCallTime.description_en: The time when the task is run next time. This parameter is displayed only when the status of the scheduled task is SUCCESS
CronNextCallTime.description_zh:
下一次调度时间。

仅当调度状态为SUCCESS时才会显示

CronStatus.description_en:
The status of the scheduled task. If this parameter is empty, it indicates the task is not run. Valid values:

PAUSE: The task is suspended.
WAITING: The task is waiting to be run.
SUCCESS: The task is complete
CronStatus.description_zh:
定时任务状态，为空表示未调度，其他取值及说明如下：

PAUSE：调度暂停。
WAITING：待调度。
SUCCESS：调度完成

CurrentClearTaskCount.description_en: The number of times that the Optimize Table statement is automatically exeuted. This parameter is valid only when the value of the OptimizeTableAfterEveryClearTimes parameter is greater than 0
CurrentClearTaskCount.description_zh: 已进行自动Optimize table的次数，仅当OptimizeTableAfterEveryClearTimes大于0时有效

Duration.description_en: The execution duration of the task. Unit: hours. If the value is 0, it indicates the duration is not specified
Duration.description_zh: 执行时长（单位：小时）。取值为0时，说明不指定执行时长

OptimizeTableAfterEveryClearTimes.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic execution of the OPTIMIZE TABLE statement. Valid values:

0: disables automatic execution
A number greater than 0: enables automatic execution. The number specifies the number of times that cleanup operations must be performed before the OPTIMIZE TABLE statement is automatically executed
OptimizeTableAfterEveryClearTimes.description_zh:
是否启用自动Optimize table，取值：

0：不启用。
大于0：启用，表示每隔多少次清理以后下次调用进行Optimize table

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the request failed
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功。
false：请求失败
